vlog.label: Vlog
priorities: The story in recorded order, with clear beats
B-roll and transitions between places
A music bed under the talking
Natural pacing (keep the personality, cut only dead air)

talking_head.label: Talking head
priorities: Pacing: silences, filler words and repeated takes
Zoom rhythm to hold attention on a single speaker
Captions for sound-off viewing
Voice clarity and loudness

interview.label: Interview
priorities: Keep every question with its answer, in order
Trim dead air between turns
Camera angle on the active speaker
Quotable moments for social

podcast.label: Podcast
priorities: Audio: clean voices at standard loudness
Dead air between turns
Readable captions
The best exchanges as shorts for social

reel.label: Reel
priorities: Hook in the first 2 seconds
Length in the platform sweet spot (TikTok 21 to 34 s, Reels 15 to 30 s, Shorts 30 to 50 s)
9:16 with the speaker framed
Bold captions kept clear of the app buttons
Energy: tight cuts, zooms, sound effects

normal.label: Prompt mode
normal.planning: Plan only the requested change. Use style rules as defaults only where the user left a choice open.
normal.execution: The normal edit pipeline plans, executes, and verifies each requested action.

auto.label: Auto mode
auto.planning: The client runs the selected style playbook as an ordered multi-step edit through the normal planner and executor.
auto.execution: This Brain response is advisory only; do not claim Auto ran or report an edit as complete.
